name: DocSend
whatYouLose: Recipients recognizing a trusted link format in fundraising
Robust download prevention (any screen can be screenshotted, but theirs is harder to strip)
Data rooms with granular permissions and NDA flows
prompt:
Build tracked document sharing, a DocSend replacement.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, PDF.js for rendering, files on disk or S3.
Features:
- Upload a PDF, create multiple share links per document (one per investor), each with optional email gate, password, expiry and download toggle.
- Viewer renders pages to canvas with PDF.js, watermarks the viewer's email on every page.
- Page-level analytics: time spent per page per visitor, total visits, completion rate; email me on first open.
- Revoke a link instantly; replace the PDF without changing links.
Done when: opening a link, reading 3 pages and closing shows per-page seconds in the dashboard.
notes: Per-page time tracking on a PDF viewer is a weekend project. The brand trust in fundraising is not.
